purpose: confirm the perps collector stopped after PERPS_COLLECTOR_ENABLED=false
sql: select date_trunc('minute', started_at) as minute, count(*) as cycles, max(started_at) as latest, round(extract(epoch from (now() - max(started_at)))::numeric,0) as seconds_since from perp_collector_cycles where started_at > now() - interval '30 minutes' group by 1 order by 1 desc limit 6
